name: ASIC Fleet
tagline: Keeps a home Bitaxe mining fleet inventoried, tuned and healthy
description: An ops helper for people running Bitaxe and ESP-Miner hashing boards at home or in a small shop. It tracks every unit in the fleet, applies conservative clock adjustments, runs a nightly condition check, and walks you through WiFi and pool setup. Automated writes stay off, and pool credentials stay out of the chat.
author: scgerber
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
